source: Men of War doctrine pack SDK, 3-game/profiles/robz.yaml bot_config (values and notes from the RobZ godny bot.data.lua). Reference only.

SplitTest.note: TEST: at the start, buy the same 10-man squad with different split values and report how many groups arrive (result: max 2)

ArrivalTimeout.note: an order whose soldiers haven't arrived after this long is treated as "unit not found" and skipped

Debug.note: writes robz_bot.log next to game.log and posts a short status in chat

ReportPeriod.note: seconds between chat status lines (Debug only)

RetargetMin.note: a unit keeps a new order at least this long before it can be sent somewhere else

InfantrySplit.note: max soldiers per bot group for infantry: 1 = every soldier gets his own orders

VehicleSplit.note: vehicles keep vehicle + crew together (splitting the crew would pull them out of the vehicle)

HoldFlags.note: false: never send groups to flags our team already holds; everyone goes for neutral/enemy flags

StageAtOwnFlags.note: true: attacks gather at the nearest held flag first (sends groups to held flags)

HoldMaxShare.note: at most this share of groups sit on flags (threatened flags ignore the cap)

FrontRange.note: a held flag is "front" if a flag we don't own is closer than this * base-to-base distance

GatherMax.note: after this long an attack launches with LaunchShare of the strength it wants...

LaunchShare.note: ...(it used to go with half, and lost men piecemeal)

WaveTimeout.note: an attack that has not taken its flag by then is called off

SwitchMargin.note: how much better another target must look before the bot changes its main target

ReorderPeriod.note: attackers get their order re-issued this often (unsticks them)

AltTriesPerSecond.note: when the preferred unit can't be bought, try up to this many alternatives each second

SaveForVehicles.note: hold money for a wanted vehicle or emplacement instead of buying more infantry

SaveMinGroups.note: ...once at least this many soldiers are on the field

SaveMaxTime.note: ...for up to this many seconds (was 90: no infantry for 1.5 min per tank)

SaveAltGap.note: while saving, still buy one cheap infantry squad every 25 s

SameUnitGap.note: the same vehicle type isn't bought again for this long (5 BA-64s in a row): mix T-60/T-70/BT/T-26

EarlyPush.note: first 5 min: light vehicles lead (no hanging back), lines assault sooner

EarlyLineMax.note: infantry waits at most 20 s on the line before going in (later: LineMax)

EarlyMaxDefenders.note: ...even against a few defenders, to get a foothold

VehMinAT.note: planned spots stay this far from known enemy AT (light 135 m; tanks 45 m: out of panzerfaust/bazooka reach)

LightFleeDist.note: enemy AT within 90 m of a light vehicle: it pulls back...

LightFleeTime.note: tanks / TDs: keep the hull toward the target (turn on the spot with the v11 DLL), close in when out of range

FaceTolTank.note: degrees off before a tank turns

FaceTolTD.note: tank destroyers have little gun traverse

FaceWait.note: while a hull turns, check again this often (no orders until it faces the target)

TurnMax.note: give a hull turn this long before firing as it stands

TurnRetry.note: ...and no new turn at that target for this long

TankSoft.note: tanks / TDs with no armour to fight attack enemy MGs, then visible infantry

TankAtSafe.note: no drive up on an MG if enemy AT soldiers stand within 45 m of the stop

DangerDist.note: soldiers walk (advance) instead of sprinting within 130 m of a known enemy MG or vehicle

UseFirePos.note: map intel: MGs / snipers / AT rifles dig in (and support attacks) at the map's firing positions

FlagValueWeight.note: map intel: attack-target bonus for the most valuable flag (contested + defensible), scaled 0-100

LearnOpenTime.note: replays: for the first 5 min, flags human players took first on this map get a bonus ...

LearnOpenWeight.note: ... this much for their first pick, less down their order

ApproachInside.note: drive to 10 m inside max range

ApproachExtra.note: ...for enemy armour up to 200 m beyond it

UnderFireHold.note: a soldier who sees an enemy within 120 m (or was hit in the last 15 s) gets no move longer than UnderFireMaxMove

UnderFireMaxMove.note: 30 m (they were sent across the map mid-firefight and shot running)

TankDirector.note: tanks/TDs aim at enemy armour the director knows of (turning to face it), not only armour in sight

ProbeWait.note: before the first purchase succeeds: try another unit after this long

BuyWaitBase.note: after that: wait this long + cost * BuyWaitPerCost for money before giving up on a unit

CooldownBase.note: a unit that could not be bought is skipped for CooldownBase * failures (max CooldownMax)

CooldownMax.note: robzbot.dll (per-unit control). Without the DLL the bot plays the old squad-to-flag way.

DisbandSquads.note: break every infantry squad up on arrival (like pressing K); vehicles keep their crew

Run.note: run when the destination is far and no enemy is close

RunDist.note: run only if the destination is farther than this (20 m). Replays: humans run ~56% of moves, the bot ran 11%

CalmDist.note: any enemy this close to the unit: walk (50 m)

CalmDestDist.note: ...or this close to where he is going (30 m)

CalmStop.note: a running man stops running only when an enemy gets this close to him (35 m)

PoseGap.note: seconds before the same soldier is given another stance order

PoseRiflemen.note: false: only gunners (MG, AT rifle, sniper) are told to lie down; riflemen keep the game's own stance

Screen.note: hold ground in front of our front-line flags instead of sitting on them

ScreenAt.note: ...this far from our flag toward the nearest flag we don't own

StageBack.note: attacks gather this far short of the target flag, on the ground between flags (35 m)

MicroPeriod.note: seconds between unit-level checks (combat reactions, anti-tank targeting)

AtRange.note: anti-tank infantry / guns engage visible enemy vehicles within this range (70 m)

TankRange.note: tanks engage visible enemy vehicles within this range (120 m; players fight armour at ~110 m)

HurtFaceRange.note: a tank/TD that is being hit attacks (turns to face) the nearest known enemy vehicle or gun within 225 m   -- tank destroyers out to 170 m (p

VehBack.note: 2026-11-02: tanks closer to the front (were 1200/1200/900)   -- (tank was 1800, td 1400: they sat behind walls at the back)

VehClearShift.note: a vehicle spot with no line of sight to the enemy (walls, houses) slides sideways in 7.5 m steps until it has one

VehMinArmor.note: and how close enemy vehicles may get

FullForce.note: 'an attack launched with this many times the strength it needs is "full force": vehicles drive in with it'

VehFollow.note: a vehicle is re-sent when the front has moved its spot by more than 20 m

AttackSpread.note: anti-tank: once enemy armour has been on the field this long with no AT gun / TD of ours, buy one (winners: ~3 min)

AtHuntRange.note: AT soldiers go after any enemy vehicle within 130 m that the director knows about, seen or not

AtkHold.note: a unit fighting a vehicle keeps at it (turning, firing) this long before the planner may move it

CrewCheck.note: enemy vehicles with no crew inside (and no gun crew next to them) are dead/abandoned: ignored

CrewDist.note: crew counted inside a vehicle within 12 m of it

GunCrewDist.note: gun crew standing within 10 m of a gun

BuyAtGuns.note: towed AT guns are not bought: AI-owned guns never move (every human gun moved, every AI gun stayed at spawn)

ProneAfter.note: a vehicle that has killed PestKills of our men (died within PestRange of it) is hunted and countered, even a jeep

BuyEmplacements.note: MG nests / mortars / light guns are not bought for now (they did not leave spawn)

LightWhenArmour.note: once the enemy has vehicles, this share of the armoured-car budget goes to tanks and AT instead     -- seconds after enemy armour appears be

AtNeedMax.note: anti-tank wanted: 1 + 2 per enemy armoured vehicle, capped (AT gun / TD = 2, AT soldier = 1)

AtCheapMax.note: before TDAfter only AT guns up to this cost (light AT guns) - plus AT rifles / bazookas

WreckAfter.note: a vehicle our AT has fired at this long...

WreckNoDamage.note: ...without losing health for this long is treated as a wreck for 5 minutes

TDAfter.note: no tank destroyers before 10 min: early armour is answered with AT soldiers and AT guns (players' first TD ~17 min)

AtGunBackMax.note: AT guns sit at our held flag one step back from the front (players: ~100 m behind the line)

EngageDist.note: 100 m (was 70 m: men under fire from 70-120 m kept walking)

CoverRadius.note: cover is looked for within 16 m of the soldier (or of his spot when he arrives)

CoverCalls.note: cover searches per check (they cost a little CPU)

EngageHold.note: seconds an engaged soldier stays down before he may move again

Disengage.note: no enemy in sight for this long: back to the plan

BoundStep.note: fire and movement: an attacker that is winning his fight moves up this far (16 m), then goes down again

BoundEvery.note: half the line moves while the other half fires, swapping every this many seconds

BoundRatio.note: bound only when our soldiers near him are at least this many times the enemies he can see

LineGap.note: the line forms this far outside the flag zone (15 m) while the flag is defended

LineSpacing.note: 5.5 m between soldiers on the line (winning humans ~5 m to the nearest friend; bot clumped)

LineMax.note: seconds a line waits before it assaults the flag anyway (only if the defence is thin by then)

AssaultRatio.note: ...or as soon as the attackers outnumber the defenders this much (director)

CapRefill.note: a capture team man killed: nobody new goes into that flag zone for 20 s (no pouring men in one by one)

CapWalkDist.note: capture team walks (doesn't sprint) into a zone with any enemy within 120 m of it

CaptureTeam.note: (was 6: bot captures were 13-22 man blobs) replays: players take a flag with ~6 men inside 50 m (about 20 within 100 m a minute before)

DigBands.note: replays: players dig in ~15 m behind a held flag and spread out to the sides (~50 m from the point)

DigSpacing.note: 9 m apart along the defensive line (players hold a ~150 m wide front)

DigClearShift.note: a spot whose view of the flag is blocked by a building is moved sideways in 4 m steps

BuildSandbags.note: soldiers who carry sandbags build a short wall in front of their spot, facing the enemy

WallsPerSpot.note: a builder puts up this many walls side by side at his spot (a proper line, not single bags)

BuildTime.note: seconds a builder is left alone to finish (no new orders, no cover moves, no AT hunting)

SpotArrive.note: a soldier within 12 m of his spot counts as there (builds sandbags, takes cover)

SpotCoverRadius.note: defenders / line soldiers are sent to the best cover facing the enemy within 20 m of their spot (was 30 m: buildings across the street)

SandbagCrowd.note: ...until this many soldiers are already using that sandbag

Fortify.note: any soldier carrying sandbags who stops somewhere puts up a wall facing the enemy

FortifyStillMG.note: machine gunners: almost as soon as they stop

FortifyEnemyMin.note: not with an enemy closer than 65 m (he'd stand up to build)

FortifyGap.note: not within 6 m of a wall we already built

FortifyHold.note: seconds he is left alone to build

MGNests.note: a gunner without sandbags gets a wall built in front of him by the nearest carrier

MGSandbagMult.note: gunners prefer sandbags 2.5x more than riflemen do, one gun per sandbag wall

ZoneMargin.note: the frontage runs 50 m past the outermost flag / spawn / map point...

ZoneMarginShare.note: ...or 8% of its length, whichever is more

ZoneOutPenalty.note: attack score lost by a flag outside our slice...

ZoneOutPerWidth.note: ...plus this per slice-width it lies outside

ZoneHelpReach.note: attacks reach at most half a slice past our edge (helping the neighbour)

ZoneHelpShare.note: a teammate's flag under attack: send this share of what we would send to our own

MGMin.note: an enemy closer than 85 m: the gunner falls back...

MGWant.note: ...to about 105 m from it; he moves up when nothing is within this

MGDigBack.note: gunners dig in 35 m behind a contested flag

MGLineBack.note: in an attack line the gunners stay 12 m behind the riflemen	-- snipers and AT riflemen get the same treatment: they stay back and shoot from

ATRMin.note: 95 m: AT riflemen fight at the rifle's max range, 100-115 m

ATRVehRange.note: AT riflemen fire at any visible enemy vehicle within 115 m before anything else

Grenades.note: switched off for now (user request 2026-10-31); smoke is separate (Smoke)

GrenadeSafe.note: not if one of our own men is within 12 m of the target

GrenadeGap.note: seconds between two grenades from one soldier

EmplaceMax.note: at most this many alive (or on order) at once

AtGunBack.note: AT guns: 100 m behind the front (players ~118 m)

EmplaceBack.note: MG nests / light guns: 60 m behind the front (players ~64 m)

GunStuckTime.note: a gun that has not moved 2 m this long after an order counts as stuck

VehStep.note: a vehicle is moved at most 75 m per order (players: ~55 m moves, the bot: 155 m)

SmokeCount.note: smokes per flag at a time (different throwers): the front edge toward the enemy, both sides, the middle

SmokeMaxFrac.note: each thrown by the man furthest from its spot who can still reach it (max range)

SmokeEvery.note: seconds between smokes on the same flag

SmokeAttackEvery.note: the flag our launched attack is going for gets smoke this often while our men close in

SingleGap.note: seconds between any two one- or two-man purchases

SingleMen.note: a purchase of this many men or fewer counts as a "single" buy

AltGap.note: seconds between two "buy something else instead" purchases (bot bought 33 times per 10 min, humans ~11)

SingleSameGap.note: seconds before the same one-man unit is bought again

SingleShare.note: one-man purchases at most this share of our soldiers (at least 3 allowed)

SingleGuessCost.note: before we have seen it arrive, a non-vehicle unit this cheap is assumed to be one man

MidHoldMin.note: strength kept on each middle flag we hold (1 = four soldiers): the capture team + men dug in around it

BuyLead.note: a unit still on cooldown is only planned for when it comes out within this many seconds

DirNear.note: enemies within the flag zone + this count as defending / attacking that flag (25 m)

DirApproach.note: enemies within the flag zone + this count as moving on that flag (100 m)

DirAvoid.note: attack-target score lost per point of enemy strength on the flag (go where they are weak)

DirAttackRatio.note: an attack wants this many times the defenders' strength before it launches

DirDefendRatio.note: a threatened flag of ours gets this many times the attackers' strength as holders
